qt: to the Commission Fabio De Masi (NI) Subject:

Has the Commission been in contact with Europol, Interpol, the EU Member States or the United Arab Emirates (UAE) regarding extradition requests or arrest warrants for the former Wirecard manager Jan Marsalek, who is wanted by Interpol and, according to media reports12, is said to have stayed temporarily in the UAE?
Does the Commission have any information about such a temporary stay?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (5.8.2025) The Commission has no competence to intervene in individual criminal investigations or proceedings. It has not exchanged any information on the case in question with Europol, Interpol, EU Member States or the United Arab Emirates.
